query: Z-Image Turbo template (image_z_image_turbo, inferred from title) outputs completely black images since 0.3.76 on a dual-GPU system: models auto-load onto cuda:1 and core-node runs are black; regenerating with MultiGpu nodes pinned to cuda:0 works.

desired.outcome: OP (Lordtzeentch38) confirmed workaround: force the model onto cuda:0 using MultiGpu nodes — image is visible; core nodes letting it load on cuda:1 stay black. Blue828 separately confirmed switching z_image_turbo_bf16 (12GB) to z-image-turbo-fp8-e4m3fn (6GB) fixed it on a 16GB 5060 Ti.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
desired.answer_guidance: OP (Lordtzeentch38) confirmed workaround: force the model onto cuda:0 using MultiGpu nodes — image is visible; core nodes letting it load on cuda:1 stay black. Blue828 separately confirmed switching z_image_turbo_bf16 (12GB) to z-image-turbo-fp8-e4m3fn (6GB) fixed it on a 16GB 5060 Ti.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Diagnose that dual-GPU auto-placement puts the model on cuda:1 where output renders black, and pin it to cuda:0 via MultiGpu nodes (or swap to the fp8 checkpoint).
